# Org skills end to end: sync them down, install them into a project's
# .claude/skills (the shape Claude Code loads), edit → publish as a markdown
# content-wrap proposal, and watch the outcome reconcile.

fulcrum sync
grep 'synced skill-corpus-writing-specs.md' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
grep 'installed corpus-writing-specs' last-stdout.txt
exists proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
cmp proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md
grep 'corpus-writing-specs' proj/.claude/skills/.fulcrum-installed.json

# Idempotent: re-running converges, no drift, no error.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
cmp proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md

# Edit the skill locally → drifted → publish sends {"content": markdown}.
cp edited-skill.md skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'drifted' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum publish --yes --note sharper
grep 'Proposal #101 submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv count 1

# The reviewer applies it; the row resolves instead of staying proposed.
srv apply 101
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'proposal #101 accepted' last-stdout.txt

-- edited-skill.md --
---
name: corpus-writing-specs
description: How this team writes request specs.
---

# corpus-writing-specs

Name the behavior, not the implementation. Sharper now.
